title: Boot loads live-projection sessions eagerly and terminal session history lazily
outcome: Finished delegation children keep no resident transcript: boot reads no tail for them and persistence trims them once their delegation is terminal, while tail, history and result-output reads serve them from SQLite on demand. Roots, live children and children of open delegations keep their tail; summary membership, prompt histories and the delegation inventory are unchanged, with no durable change.
acceptance: A boot over a store holding finished delegation children (delegation terminal, child idle or failed, nothing queued, running or pending) reads no transcript tail for those children before /api/state is served, proven by a test that counts tail reads per session on the production boot path; roots, live children and children of open delegations still load their tail.

Every per-id tail, history page and delegation result-output read after boot returns the same content as before this change for roots, live children, finished children and dangling links, covered by tests on a real temporary SQLite store; a full and a delta persistence while a child is cold, then a follow-up append and a reopen, keep every original position, id and body.

The measured boot duration and resident memory before this change are recorded on the item, and the measurement after the restart is carried by w-e5a0838445b6; the full gate passes on the exact committed tree with a clean independent review pair.

completion.summary:
Finished delegation children now keep no resident transcript, and boot reads no tail for them. That includes a child whose own delegations are all terminal, unless an evaluator's card can still be rewritten. Persistence trims them once their delegation is terminal and nothing transient holds them, and every wake that can release a held child rechecks it. Tail, history, delegation result-output and the project digest's progress read them from SQLite on demand. A follow-up or review capture makes the window resident again; so does a follow-up for the parent whose card it rewrites.

The change landed in batch b35c79d17bf7dcbb5bb2477a56b6176e18355c45 on master (fast-forwarded and pushed by Opus2 at 2026-11-23T01:27:55Z). The batch also carries the federation fixture diagnostics for w-2f9db62028e0.
